A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] '''member''' of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], under the callsign [[Rogue Ten/Legends|Rogue Ten]], was present during the [[Second Battle of Sernpidal]] in late [[26 ABY]]. The [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] flew in the Rogues' [[Three Flight]] alongside [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Lensi]], and was killed approaching the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] perimeter after a collision with an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].
